reviews.comment: Luiza is the BEST professor for Spanish. She sets up her class in an engaging way and really listens to student feedback. Her class is a little different than the other sections but I really enjoyed her teaching style. I took 102-202 with her and I highly recommend her class. Show up and study hard, you will get an A and learn a lot of Spanish.

Although I didn't enjoy her class, I'm sure many people would. There were only two tests, three oral presentations, and lots of group mini projects. The quizzes over the short story can be difficult to comprehend, even as an advanced student, so please read and reread the book. Homework was easy. PHYSICAL BOOK IS WORTH IT FOR STUDYING OFF COMPUTER.

Luiza is very caring about her students. She's very passionate and was the best professor I had for Spanish, the best part is she is very flexible with homework dates and she is easy to communicate with outside of class. Just show up for class and complete your work! Participation matters but it helps you learn anyway. Would take her again!

Luiza is an amazing person and an incredible professor. The class is advanced grammar which is boring and difficult but Luiza makes it very interesting and the class feels like a discussion. Class is almost entirely taught in Spanish. If you need to take 302, take Luiza.
